issues.feedback: The proposed new test does not verify the explicit requirement to use the last `item.completed` + `item.type == "agent_message"` when multiple exist. Add a test with two agent_message events and assert the second one wins.

The spec says `role:assistant` parsing is a secondary fallback, but the described additive logic does not enforce that. In mixed streams, later flat-format lines could overwrite event-based text. Define explicit precedence (e.g., track event text separately and prefer it over flat-role text).

The approach relies on top-level key presence for `thread_id` and `usage` rather than checking `type == "thread.started"` / `type == "turn.completed"`. That is feasible today but weakly specified and can mis-extract if future events include those keys. Scope extraction to the intended event types for correctness and clarity.
